papers.paper: First Semester Examination 2022/2023 Session (CSC 475: Professional Ethics for Computer Science). Answer any three questions, twenty marks each; 1 hour 30 minutes
papers.source: 400 Level PQ.pdf (the 400 Level past-questions file in the shared Drive folder; text read from Drive's extraction, obvious scanning errors corrected); the handwritten notes on the copy are not included

questions.text:
Explain your actions/decisions using applicable ethical theories. (4 marks each)
a. If something at an open market is far more valuable than the posted price, do I have to let the seller know?
b. Is it considered stealing to take pens from a bank? What about extra pens from an exhibition?
c. The IT Manager gave me credit for a mobile app project on which a colleague did most of the work. Should I accept the praise?
d. Am I obligated to lend money to friends and family?
e. The IT Manager asked me to cover for him on his expense report by increasing the price of SSD drives. Should I do it?

You have been studying for the past two weeks for your final exam in the college. Your grade in the class is much lower than it should be, and your father has warned you to improve or there will be consequences. So declining invitations for parties, restricting your time with friends, and spending hours in the library, you have done a lot to prepare for this exam. On the exam day you sit next to a mutual friend of yours that lives on the same floor in the hostel. Talking with him before the test begins, you notice that this friend has hidden a cheat sheet at the top of his backpack.

Ordinarily, you wouldn't be concerned about it; however, the professor has already announced that only limited students would pass the exam. Even if everyone does really well, the professor will divide up the grades to make sure there's a limited amount of A's and B's.

a. What are the options available to you? (6 marks)
b. Discuss each of these options (9 marks) and choose the option you would adopt, giving reasons (5 marks).

a. Inga sells hardware and software to over 100 000 customers per year. She has 10 years' experience. As part of the billing process she keeps information on customers. She buys and uses a data mining tool to derive useful information about her client's information such as zip codes, credit card numbers, ID numbers etc. Most of this information identifies groups and not individuals. She can then use the information to market her wares more efficiently. Is this ethical since customers did not give her the information for this purpose? Discuss five ways Inga's company can ensure confidentiality. (10 marks)

b. John invests small amounts on the stock market. Last year he bought and successfully employed a software package to help him with his investments. Recently, he met Mary who was also interested in using the software. Mary borrowed the package, copied it and then returned it. Both vaguely knew that the software was proprietary but did not read up the details. Did John and Mary do anything wrong, if so what? Should software packages be lent? Is there a conflict of interest here? Explain five (5) ways Conflict of Interest can arise in a computer organization. (10 marks)

a. Briefly explain any five (5) stages of ethics development. (10 marks)
b. Using examples, describe any five (5) characteristics of a computer professional. (10 marks)

a. List five (5) specializations within the computer profession. (5 marks)
b. Discuss one of the dominant work ethics that exist i.e. protestant, confucian, etc. (5 marks)
c. Explain any five (5) dimensions of work ethics from a computer professional's perspective. (10 marks)
